name: sim_xgi_capability
purpose: Tool-capability isolation probe for xgi -- unblocks load-bearing hypergraph use.

pytorch.reason: not used: this XGI capability fixture does not need tensor autodiff, torch modules, or dense tensor kernels.

pyg.reason: not used: no PyG Data object, edge index, message passing, batching, or graph pooling API is exercised.

z3.reason: not used: no SMT satisfiability, model extraction, or constraint proof obligation is part of this fixture.

cvc5.reason: not used: no cvc5 formula assertion, SAT check, value extraction, or SyGuS synthesis surface is needed.

sympy.reason: not used: no symbolic algebra, polynomial manipulation, or exact matrix identity proof is required.

clifford.reason: not used: no Clifford basis, multivector product, rotor, or grade projection is represented.

geomstats.reason: not used: no manifold metric, geodesic computation, or Lie group geometry API is part of this probe.

e3nn.reason: not used: this XGI capability receipt exercises discrete hypergraph incidence and connected components, not SO(3)-equivariant neural operations.

rustworkx.reason: not used: no DAG, graph traversal, shortest path, or dependency graph API is part of this hypergraph fixture.

xgi.reason: capability under test -- Hypergraph construction / degree / incidence / CC / simplicial lift

toponetx.reason: not used: no cell complex, simplicial complex, Hasse graph, or incidence-matrix API from TopoNetX is exercised.

gudhi.reason: not used: no persistent homology, simplex tree, filtration, or Betti-number computation is needed.

networkx.reason: not used: the connected-component baseline is a local union-find implementation, not a NetworkX graph call.

connected_components_vs_baseline.detail: all 6 nodes should be in one component via edge chain

non_iterable_edge_raises.detail: xgi must refuse a non-iterable hyperedge

missing_node_degree_raises.detail: degree() on a nonexistent node must raise (IDNotFound or similar)

empty_hypergraph.detail: empty Hypergraph must have 0 nodes and 0 edges

singleton_hyperedge_behavior.detail: xgi must either accept size-1 edges cleanly or raise; silent refusal fails

operation_sequence: construct a finite XGI Hypergraph with six nodes and four mixed-size hyperedges
query incident hyperedges for a selected node
compare XGI connected components against a manual union-find baseline over hyperedge co-membership
exercise simplicial-lift behavior or a downward-closed hypergraph fallback depending on installed XGI API surface

run adjacent negative and boundary fixtures for disconnected components, invalid edge insertion, missing node degree query, empty hypergraph, singleton component, singleton hyperedge behavior, and one large hyperedge

carrier_topology.positive_fixture: six-node connected hypergraph with four mixed-size hyperedges

observable.primary: hyperedge incidence, degree sequence, edge size sequence, and connected-component partition
secondary: incident edge membership for a selected node

pass: constructed hypergraph has six nodes and four hyperedges
degree sequence equals the hand-computed node membership counts
edge-size sequence equals the hand-computed hyperedge sizes
node 2 belongs to exactly two incident hyperedges and each contains node 2
XGI connected components match manual union-find co-membership components
simplicial-lift or fallback downward-closed hypergraph contains required faces
disconnected two-edge hypergraph has two components
degree query for missing node raises
empty, singleton, singleton-hyperedge, and one-big-hyperedge boundary checks pass
fail: any construction, degree, incidence, component, invalid-input, or boundary check misses its expected hypergraph invariant

graveyards.name: disconnected_two_hyperedges
graveyards.change: replace the connected hyperedge chain with two disjoint size-2 hyperedges
graveyards.expected_death: connected-component count becomes two instead of one

graveyards.name: non_iterable_edge
graveyards.change: attempt to add integer 42 as a hyperedge
graveyards.expected_death: XGI raises rather than constructing a decorative edge

graveyards.name: missing_node_degree
graveyards.change: query degree for a node not present in the hypergraph
graveyards.expected_death: degree lookup raises instead of inventing a value

baselines.name: manual_union_find_components
baselines.role: pure Python baseline for hyperedge co-membership connected components

baselines.name: hand_counted_degree_and_size_sequences
baselines.role: manual baseline for node memberships and hyperedge arities

alternative_formulations: NetworkX clique expansion followed by connected-component comparison
TopoNetX rank-2 cell incidence representation of the same hyperedge families
manual incidence matrix with rows as nodes and columns as hyperedges
surviving_alternatives: This receipt covers only bounded XGI hypergraph construction, incidence, connected components, and simplicial-lift behavior; it does not prove downstream hypergraph lego claims.
demotion_condition: Demote this XGI capability receipt if Hypergraph construction, degree queries, incidence lookups, connected-component agreement, or boundary edge behavior fails on rerun.
claim_ceiling: finite sim_xgi_capability lego receipt only; no bridge, GStack, axis, QIT, or nonclassical admission
next_lego_target: Use as bounded XGI hypergraph capability evidence before exact hypergraph lego-fit or coupling packets.
promotion_condition: Requires separate coupling/coexistence receipts and explicit stage-gate approval.
blocked_until: explicit coupling-stage admission and companion receipts
